newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Amoco sees Venezuela Jusepin reserves 100 mln bbl.
newsitem.headline: Amoco sees Venezuela Jusepin reserves 100 mln bbl.

text.p: Light crude oil reserves at Amoco's Jusepin field in north-eastern Venezuela are estimated to be at least 100 million barrels, Amoco president William Lowrie said.
"I would say there are at least 100 million barrels," Lowrie told reporters after addressing an oil conference in Caracas.
Amoco has been operating the field with France's Total since 1995 and earlier this year the companies reported two successful finds at the field.
"It has been very encouraging, very positive," said Alex Weisselberg, head of Amoco de Venezuela. A third exploratory well is currently being drilled.
Amoco, which recently purchased exploration and production rights for two other areas in Venezuela, has still not booked any reserves for the country, Lowrie said.
Weisselman said Amoco will invest between 90 and 100 million dollars in exploration in Venezuela this year.
